name: Red collage
what: Three bold lines slam in under your chin - white, red, white - with a small tag and a blinking red dot above them, off your face. It comes with the whole look: the picture turns black and white and a giant red word stands behind you (the word-behind graphic).
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: the tag fades in over f0-f4, its red dot blinking every 6 f; from f2 a line slams in every 4 frames: from 145 % to its size in 5 f (slow end), fading in over 3 f and sharpening from a 7 px blur over 4 f; as each lands the block jolts 3.5 px, dying over 6 f; the block drifts 2.5 % larger while it holds (S-curve); the last 9 f the lines slide 70 px left and fade one a frame apart, the tag with them (accelerating).

tracks.name: out
tracks.what: the lines slide out one after another

min_why: every line slams in and is read before they slide out
